pages.title: Transfinite Processor
pages.text: The seventh tier of processor. It completes infinitely many operations in finite time, a supertask like Zeno's runner who halves each step. An aleph-null shard keeps count and a Godel sentence marks the limits it cannot pass. It is perfectly silent.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)On the Femtoscale Assembly Line, I paired an Ontological Processor with an Aleph-Null Shard and a Godel Sentence. It ran an infinite loop, finished, and reported the answer before I had asked.

Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Incompleteness.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Key, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Omnilex Engine, Omnilex Seal, Transfinite Lattice Bolt.
